name: memory_ask
description: Required before acting on a person, account, deal, or thread. Ask what we already know. An unavailable response is not evidence that no knowledge exists. Pass kind:name ids in entities, e.g. person:jane@acme.com or org:acme.

entities.description: kind:name ids to scope the ask, e.g. ["org:acme", "person:jane@acme.com"]. Empty means everything visible. Never pass a bare name; Memory stores that as unknown.

name: memory_search
description: Search claims visible in the selected Memory workspace by literal text or semantic meaning.

entities.description: Restrict to claims linked to these kind:name ids, e.g. person:jane@acme.com.

name: memory_entities
description: Discover existing entity identifiers in shared workspace memory before creating new spellings. Reuse returned ids on later ask/report calls.

kind.description: Optional filter: org, person, team, repo, product.

name: memory_report
description: Required once per interesting item inspected, including ones not surfaced. File one concise fact with a source pointer. Skip bulk, billing, and thanks. actor is the observed person, not this agent. A queued receipt means Studio stored the report for later delivery, not that Memory has extracted claims. Payload limit is 64 KiB.

actor.description: person:<name> or person:<email> — who this report observed, e.g. person:ceo or person:jane@acme.com. Prefer the email form when known. Never you; never a bare name without the person: prefix.

owner.description: person: or team: entity that owns the source artifact. Defaults to the acting Studio user.

occurred_at.description: Original event time in ISO 8601 format.

external_id.description: Stable source-item identifier, reused for replay.

anyOf.description: kind:name id, e.g. person:jane@acme.com or org:acme.

id.description: kind:name id, e.g. person:jane-doe. May be omitted for a person when email is given.

email.description: The person's email — the strongest identity key. Always include it when the source shows one.

entities.description: kind:name ids this fact concerns — e.g. ["org:acme", "person:jane-doe"]. Kinds: org (customer/account), person, team, repo, product. For people prefer person:<email> or the object form with email. Bare names without a kind prefix are stored as unknown, not as people.
